info.title: Pilio Public API
info.description: Public API for Pilio GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, image watermark removal, background removal, image upscale, and PDF watermark removal tasks. API tasks reuse the normal Pilio credit balance, and standard pricing matches the web base credit cost at 1x; explicitly configured accounts may have a custom multiplier. This specification is optimized for AI coding agents: create files first, upload to presigned URLs, create tasks with file IDs, poll status, then download result URLs. GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst have dedicated create and quote endpoints.

post.summary: Create a GPT Image 2 image task
post.description: Creates an asynchronous GPT Image 2 task. Send only a prompt for text-to-image, or include image_file_ids for reference-image editing or composition. aspect_ratio and resolution are independent parameters: auto is passed through unchanged, omitted/1K requests use AI Gateway, and 2K/4K requests use the existing KIE channel.

value.prompt: A cinematic product photo of an orange perfume bottle
Turn these references into a polished studio product photo

post.summary: Quote a GPT Image 2 request without creating a task
post.description: Validates the same request shape and returns the same server-side pricing snapshot used by task creation. This endpoint does not create a task, call an upstream provider, or consume credits. Use charged_credits to enforce a client-side budget before calling the creation endpoint.

example.prompt: A centered red product icon on a plain background

200.description: Validated quote; no task was created and no credits were consumed

post.description: Creates a PDF watermark removal task. editable mode uses structured removal; ai mode reconstructs pages as images.

get.description: Poll task status until Succeeded or Failed. Start with a 2 second interval and back off to 5 seconds for long tasks.
Returns result files after task success. Download files directly from files[].download_url or zip_file.download_url. These URLs are temporary; call this endpoint again after expiration.

post.description: Creates file records and returns presigned PUT URLs. Use upload_url for a single upload followed by /v1/files/{id}/complete with upload_mode=single. Use upload_urls for multipart upload followed by /v1/files/{id}/complete with upload_mode=multipart and parts. Do not send the Pilio API Key to presigned upload URLs. Use returned items[].id as image_file_id, image_file_ids, or pdf_file_id when creating tasks.
Confirms a file upload after all presigned PUT requests succeed. Single upload_url and multipart upload_urls flows both call this endpoint; multipart requests also merge object storage parts.

apiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: Compatibility header for Pilio API keys.

TaskId.name: id
TaskId.description: Task ID returned by a task creation endpoint.

code.description: 200 means success; other values indicate errors.

base_credits.description: Web base credit cost in display units, represented as an exact decimal string.

charged_credits.description: Developer API credit cost in display units after applying the account multiplier. Compare this exact decimal string against your budget before task creation.

available_credits.description: Current available credit balance in display units, represented as an exact decimal string.

credits_multiplier_bps.description: Applied developer API multiplier in basis points; standard web-parity pricing is 10000 (1x), while account-specific rates may differ.

download_url.description: Temporary result download URL. Use GET directly. Do not send the Pilio API Key.

image_file_ids.description: Optional reference image file IDs. Omit for text-to-image; pass 1 to 16 file IDs for reference-image editing or composition. Supported input formats: jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

aspect_ratio.description: Required when image_file_ids is omitted. Optional when reference images are provided. auto is passed through unchanged. 2K/4K do not support 4:5, 5:4, or 7:4.

resolution.description: Optional output resolution tier. Omitted/1K requests use AI Gateway; 2K/4K requests use the existing KIE channel.

quality.description: Advanced optional tier: auto, low, medium, or high. Defaults to auto. It affects detail, compute effort, and generation time, not resolution.

image_file_ids.description: Optional reference image file IDs. Omit for text-to-image; pass 1 to 14 file IDs for reference-image editing or composition. Supported input formats: jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

aspect_ratio.description: Required when image_file_ids is omitted. Optional when reference images are provided.

boxes.description: Required when mode is manual. Coordinates are percentages of image width and height.

image_file_id.description: File ID of the image to process. Supported input formats: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, heic.

trim_transparent_background.description: Trim extra transparent canvas around the cutout.

image_file_id.description: File ID of the image to process. Supported input formats: heic, jpg, png, webp.

pdf_file_id.description: File ID of the PDF to process.

mode.description: editable uses structured watermark removal; ai reconstructs pages as images.

nanoid.description: Client-generated 21-character nanoid used to match local files.

name.description: Original file name. The suffix must match type.

type.description: File type, such as png, jpg, jpeg, webp, or pdf.

upload_mode.description: Upload mode. auto selects single PUT or multipart upload by file size. simple only accepts one upload_url and returns an error when the file exceeds the simple upload threshold. multipart may return upload_urls and requires the complete flow.

storage_intent.description: Storage intent. Reference images usually use temporary.

upload_url.description: Single-file presigned PUT upload URL. Do not send the Pilio API Key. No complete call is needed after upload.

upload_urls.description: Multipart presigned PUT upload URLs for large files. Upload in order and collect the ETag response header from each part. Do not send the Pilio API Key.

upload_mode.description: Use single for upload_url uploads and multipart for upload_urls uploads.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed upload time in milliseconds, measured from upload start until all presigned PUT requests succeed.

size.description: Client-observed file size in bytes. The server prefers the size stored on the file record.

parts.description: Multipart upload completion data. Required when upload_mode is multipart. part_number must start from 1 and remain consecutive. etag comes from each part PUT response header.

CommonErrorCode.description: Common business errors surfaced by the public API.

examples.meaning: API Key missing, invalid, or revoked
Too many files in one batch-create request
Multipart upload not found or expired
examples.fix: Create a new file upload and retry all parts.

examples.meaning: Object was not uploaded before task creation
examples.fix: Finish PUT upload before creating the task.

image_file_ids.description: Optional reference image file IDs. Omit for text-to-image; pass 1 to 16 file IDs for reference-image editing or composition. Supported input formats: jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio. Defaults to auto.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier, default 1K. Actual pixel dimensions depend on aspect ratio. 4K is approximately 8.3 megapixels (for example 3840x2160 at 16:9), not a guarantee of 4096x4096.

rules: Send the Pilio API Key only to https://pilio.ai/v1/* endpoints.
Do not send the Pilio API Key to upload_url, upload_urls, or download_url.
When creating tasks, pass FileUploadItem.id as image_file_id, image_file_ids, or pdf_file_id. Do not pass nanoid, upload_id, upload_url, or upload_urls.
For the simplest image upload flow, set upload_mode to simple so oversized files fail instead of returning multipart upload_urls.
If batch-create returns upload_url, PUT the raw file once, then call /v1/files/{id}/complete with upload_mode=single.
If batch-create returns upload_urls, PUT chunks in order, collect each ETag response header, then call /v1/files/{id}/complete with upload_mode=multipart and parts.
Poll task status until Succeeded or Failed. Do not parse natural-language message strings to infer task state.
